tools.name: get_service_overview
tools.description: What 4fillment does: warehouses, services, service levels, product rules, and how to get started.

tools.name: get_rate_card
tools.description: The published 3PL rate card with its version: receiving, storage, pick & pack by weight, extras, monthly minimum and add-ons.

tools.name: estimate_monthly_cost
tools.description: Line-by-line monthly fee estimate from order volume, weight, storage and extras, with the monthly minimum applied. Non-standard packaging returns custom_quote_required.

tools.name: check_product_eligibility
tools.description: Says whether products are allowed, need review, or are prohibited at our warehouse. Guidance only; the binding check happens at receiving.

tools.name: ask_4fillment
tools.description: Answers a question about 4fillment from its approved answers, each with its source. Reports when no approved answer exists.

tools.name: ask_a_person
tools.description: Opens a support case so a person at 4fillment replies by e-mail. Returns a case reference and an access token. Takes the reply e-mail address, a category, a summary, and optional order, SKU, shipment or tracking numbers.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: The status of a 4fillment support case: open, answered or closed, and when a person replies. Needs the case reference and its access token.
